title: SyncResponse
description: JSON-RPC response for the unified sync method. Returns all changed rows across all services since lastSyncTime.

cursor.description: Pass to the next sync call. Opaque: clients must not parse or generate it.

reset.description: The cursor sent was older than the tombstone retention window, so deletes it never saw have already been purged. `data` is a full snapshot: clients must discard their synced stores before applying it, or a record deleted while they were away lingers forever.

errors.description: Resources that could not be fetched this round. The rest of the response is still usable; clients keep their previous cursor so the failed resources are retried.
